resources.string: Tap the accessibility button to speak. Handy uses the microphone and inserts the result at the cursor using your speech and post-processing settings.
In Android Accessibility settings, turn on Handy Dictation. Under its shortcut, choose Accessibility button. Then tap a text field and press the button once to dictate.
Handy Dictation is on. Choose Accessibility button as its shortcut. Tap the button in a text field and speak. Pausing inserts the text.
Open Accessibility in Android Settings and select Handy Dictation.
